inputs: frozen v05 15 source-PTS candidate pools and all-pair evidence; no oracle prototypes or reference labels in predictor
pair_support: unchanged v05: (verified P1.4 SIFT AND HSV<=0.5) OR (HSV<=0.12 AND gray<=0.035); failed/no SIFT means missing support only
candidate_core: v05 accepted complete-link groups, >=4 source frames spanning >=0.4s; choose medoid, farthest HSV, farthest source time, maximum3; own frame never supplies evidence
near_duplicate_policy: reference views greedily collapsed if both distances pass; normalize evidence by view units, never sum duplicate counts into confidence; temporal repeats are corroboration, not independent held-out views
association: candidate-core pair needs >=2 direct supported cross pairs covering >=2 reference source frames on each side, supported cross fraction>=0.35; greedy degree-first complete-link over candidate relations, never connected components or transitive chain; all original refs retained, max24 total refs/group
association_budget: one pass before recognition; no later promotion or re-association; no forced group count
confidence: categorical evidence, not probability: high requires quality, direct core support from >=2 references spanning >=0.4s, absolute best HSV<=0.5 and unique relative HSV margin>=0.2; medium requires any direct support but high gate missing; low lacks direct support or quality; accepted scene_id initially only high
relative_margin_formula: (runner_supported_HSV-best_supported_HSV)/(runner_supported_HSV+best_supported_HSV+1e-9); no supported runner ->1; rank by supported then HSV; no averaging HSV/SIFT scales
competition: record every multi-group support with common frame/core pairs and time; decisive margin can resolve competition, otherwise unknown; simultaneous SIFT alone no blanket veto and no transition claim
extension: one simultaneous pass from original high rows only; quality+direct core support+unique margin required; initial high neighbor same group within0.6s AND all intervening links registered with (motion support OR raw MAD<=0.035 OR brightness explanation); never use newly extended members to authorize another frame
extension_range: initial midpoint territory clipped to <=1s beyond initial reliable run; no assignment from time alone; out-of-side core evidence logged, not deleted; single run has no midpoint and open ranges stay unknown unless explicit direct-core+continuity acceptance
midpoint_revision: recompute occurrences once with accepted extensions; record original and revised brackets; never external endpoints; newly independent groups only flagged, no recursive split
transition_gate: two reliable group occurrences plus signed HSV contrast endpoint progression>=0.4 AND at least one active non-photometric visual link; unknown/dual support alone is not transition; failed gate retains ambiguous bracket
selector: byte-unchanged v05.engine.deliver/choose, budget8; same candidates and native export/no autorotate; retain unsplit V/uniform controls and actual resample
versions: v06-core (no extension, no midpoint transition revision)
v06-full (same frozen core + one extension + one midpoint/transition revision)
evaluation: locked existing clear A/B points excluding common union of old prototypes and new cores for fair pair comparison; additionally all reviewed and per-version noncore stats; labels only after predictions. All 15 full downstream for both variants. Reference endpoints only evaluate first chronological candidate, never select best. Report null when missing. Same-space synthetic/real-pan split warnings; no physical identity/generalization accuracy. One chain/weak-bridge contract counterexample.
stop: one core selection/association, one initial recognition, <=min(48,ceil(0.25*N)) simultaneous extensions, one interval revision, one fresh source resample per variant; no threshold search/model/VLM/Agent calls
